source_of_truth.rule: Resolve the newest explicitly canonical evidence before comparing state.

decision_rule: DENY unless identity, policy, lease scope, provenance, and evidence requirements all pass.

controls.name: untrusted event isolation
requirements: Never use pull_request_target or workflow_run for untrusted repository code.
A pull_request job must not receive secrets or an OIDC token.
Workflow permissions are explicitly least privilege.

controls.name: identity and model separation
requirements: A selected model is runtime provenance, not identity, seat, or authority.
The concrete model and interface selection are recorded in the runtime envelope.

controls.name: capability lease boundary
requirements: Leases are short lived, exact scoped, revocable, nonce protected, and audited.
Lease verification cannot broaden the governing specification or policy decision.
No durable plaintext secret is embedded in a lease or browser payload.

controls.name: dependency and action provenance
requirements: Dependency upgrades change the direct declaration, override, and lockfile together.
Production admission requires a reviewed exact-head proof and a provenance record.
New workflow action references are pinned to immutable commit SHAs.

controls.name: deployment admission
requirements: A READY preview is evidence of a build, not production approval.
Production deployment requires a reviewed SHA, successful governed checks, and a bounded receipt.
DNS remains unknown until authoritative DNS evidence is collected.

controls.name: evidence and response
requirements: Every deny, contain, or revoke decision has a sanitized correlation and evidence reference.
Unknown and partially knowable states remain explicit and cannot be promoted by omission.
Recovery is a new reviewed transition, not an implicit retry.
